decisions.text: Order of presentations: Presentations will be given in the order that was initially mentioned by A (user requirements, effects, working design).
Remote control functions to be decided upon during the meeting.
Not working with teletext due to it being taken over by the internet.
Management has decided not to work with Ceefax-like technology for the remote.
Focus on designing the remote for television only, not for other devices like video or general electronics.
The remote should be sold separately from the television for now.
The price of the remote is set at 25 Euros.
The target age group for the remote is under 65 years old.
The remote should include large, accessible buttons for essential functions.
The remote should have a feature to help locate it if lost (e.g., a beep or ring function).
The remote should have a possibility to access extra functions, which can be hidden or less prominent.
The remote should be fashionable and aesthetically pleasing.
The remote should incorporate a long-life or rechargeable battery option.
The remote should emphasize simplicity and fashion as core design goals.
Voice recognition will not be included in the remote due to cost and complexity.
The remote should have a design that includes the company's yellow color and slogan.
The remote should have a design that combines fashion with electronics.
The remote should have a design that includes the double 'R_' logo prominently.
